chart.name: Bytes/request
chart.programText:
A = data('apache_bytes', rollup='rate').publish(label='A', enable=False)
B = data('apache_requests', rollup='rate').publish(label='B', enable=False)
C = (A/B).publish(label='C')

chart.name: Requests/sec 24h change %
chart.programText:
A = data('apache_requests', rollup='rate').mean(over='1h').publish(label='A', enable=False)
B = (A).timeshift('1d').publish(label='B', enable=False)
C = (A/B-1).scale(100).publish(label='C')

chart.name: Requests/sec 24h change %
chart.programText:

chart.name: Total running worker threads
chart.programText:
A = data('apache_connections', filter=filter('plugin', 'apache')).sum().publish(label='A')
B = data('apache_idle_workers', filter=filter('plugin', 'apache')).sum().publish(label='B')

chart.name: Avg bytes/request
chart.programText:
A = data('apache_bytes', filter=filter('plugin', 'apache'),rollup='rate').sum().publish(label='A', enable=False)
B = data('apache_requests', filter=filter('plugin', 'apache'),rollup='rate').sum().publish(label='B', enable=False)
C = (A/B).publish(label='C')

chart.name: Requests/sec
chart.programText:
A = data('apache_requests', filter=filter('plugin', 'apache'),rollup='rate').publish(label='A', enable=False)
B = (A).min().publish(label='B')
C = (A).percentile(pct=10).publish(label='C')
D = (A).percentile(pct=50).publish(label='D')
E = (A).percentile(pct=90).publish(label='E')
F = (A).max().publish(label='F')
